limits: One successful final-head run and queue attempt, not a controlled host-speed experiment or guaranteed latency.
Checkout, restoration, build and TAP totals overlap in different job phases; do not add them as disjoint costs.
All-world negative control runtime did not improve materially. Fixture-preparation equivalence is independently measured, not an end-to-end kernel speedup.
Hosted logs are independently retrievable by run/job IDs at observation time; the compact report retains their hashes, not the full bodies.
History lane is established by real selector controls; no history campaign, production write or provider action was invented for benchmarking.
